name: license_status
description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

name: license_activate
description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: License key from the checkout confirmation page

name: zip_create
description: Call this tool to pack files or a whole directory (with glob patterns) into a new .zip at out_path. Entry names are always relative, so the archive cannot write outside where it is unpacked.

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the .zip. A directory, a missing parent or an existing file without overwrite is refused before anything is packed

arguments.name: paths
arguments.desc: Files to pack, each stored under its own file name. A directory here contributes its whole tree under its own name

arguments.name: dir
arguments.desc: Pack this directory's tree; entry names are relative to it

arguments.name: patterns
arguments.desc: Only entries matching one of these globs (* and ? inside a segment, ** across segments; a pattern with no slash also matches the file name at any depth)

arguments.name: exclude
arguments.desc: Drop entries matching one of these globs, applied after patterns

arguments.name: level
arguments.desc: Deflate level 0 to 9, default 6. 0 stores without compressing

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if a file is already there. Default false: an existing file is never overwritten

arguments.name: password
arguments.desc: Not supported. Passing it is refused rather than ignored, so no one believes an archive is encrypted when it is not

name: zip_list
description: Call this tool to list an archive's entries with sizes, compressed sizes and ratios, and to flag what is dangerous in it: absolute paths, .., symlinks, encrypted entries, duplicate names and compression bombs.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Path to the .zip file. Read-only: the archive is never modified and nothing is extracted

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: How many entries to print, largest first (default 50). The totals always cover every entry

arguments.name: patterns
arguments.desc: Only entries matching one of these globs

arguments.name: max_ratio
arguments.desc: Flag an entry whose uncompressed/compressed ratio is above this. Default 100

name: zip_extract
description: Call this tool to unpack an archive into out_dir. Traversal, absolute-path and symlink entries are refused, a size and ratio cap stops a zip bomb, and dry_run reports exactly what would be written.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Path to the .zip file

arguments.name: out_dir
arguments.desc: Directory to unpack into. It is created if missing; every file written is checked to land inside it

arguments.name: patterns
arguments.desc: Only entries matching one of these globs (* and ? inside a segment, ** across segments)

arguments.name: dry_run
arguments.desc: Report what would be written, byte counts included, and write nothing

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace files that already exist in out_dir. Default false: the whole extraction is refused if any would be replaced

arguments.name: skip_unsafe
arguments.desc: Skip the dangerous entries and extract the rest, naming what was skipped. Default false: one bad entry refuses the whole archive

arguments.name: max_total_mb
arguments.desc: Refuse if the selected entries declare more than this uncompressed. Default 1024

arguments.name: max_ratio
arguments.desc: Refuse an entry whose uncompressed/compressed ratio is above this. Default 100

name: zip_add
description: Call this tool to add files to an existing archive. The archive is rebuilt from its entries and written tmp-then-rename, so a failure part way leaves the original file exactly as it was.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Path to the existing .zip file

arguments.name: paths
arguments.desc: Files to add, each stored under its own file name. A directory contributes its tree under its own name

arguments.name: prefix
arguments.desc: Put the new entries under this folder inside the archive, for example "invoices"

arguments.name: replace
arguments.desc: Replace an entry whose name is already in the archive. Default false: a name clash is refused and nothing is changed

arguments.name: level
arguments.desc: Deflate level 0 to 9 for the new entries, default 6

arguments.name: password
arguments.desc: Not supported. Passing it is refused rather than ignored

name: zip_extract_text
description: Call this tool to read one text entry out of an archive without unpacking anything: give the entry name and the text comes back inline. Binary entries are refused by name rather than printed as noise.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Path to the .zip file

arguments.name: entry
arguments.desc: Exact entry name, as zip_list prints it. A glob is accepted when it matches exactly one entry

arguments.name: max_chars
arguments.desc: Stop after this many characters (default 200000). The answer says when it was cut

name: zip_bundle_month
description: Call this tool to zip one month of invoices, quotes and exports written by the sibling servers into their default output folders. Best effort: it names every folder it looked in and what it found.

arguments.name: month
arguments.desc: Month as YYYY-MM. Default: this month. Files are chosen by their modification date

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the .zip. Default: <data dir>/bundles/<month>.zip

arguments.name: servers
arguments.desc: Only these sibling servers: invoice, quotes, expense-tracker, docx, resume. Default: all five

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if it exists. Default false

arguments.name: dry_run
arguments.desc: Report what would go in and write nothing

name: zip_history
description: List the archives this server created, newest first, with their entry counts and sizes, plus how many of this month's free allowance are left.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: How many rows to show, newest first (default 20)
